english.title: Publish advertisement to sell / buy non-Schedule 1 wild bird or egg
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), published an advertisement which was likely to be understood as conveying that you would buy or sell, or intended to buy or sell,

(A)_[a live wild bird,]_
(B)_[live wild birds,]_
(C)_[a wild bird's egg or any part thereof,]_
(D)_[a wild bird's eggs or any part thereof,]_
(E)_[wild birds' eggs or any part thereof,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY SPECIES OF BIRD(S)..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 6(1)(b) and 21(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
advertise
to sell / buy
live non Schedule 1 wild bird(s)/egg(s)/any part thereof

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Does not apply to birds listed in Part I of Schedule 3 to the Act.
(ii) See Section 27 for meaning of "advertisement", "sale" and "wild bird".
(iii) See Section 21(6) for the forfeiture provisions.
(iv) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes.
(v) As amended by paragraph 10 of Schedule 12 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
(vi) See offence wording: H4597.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Where more than one bird or egg is involved in a single offence the maximum fine shall be determined as if the person convicted had been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each bird or egg (Section 21(5)).

Complex - see legislation
